answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost per identity that cannot be farmed. Each agent posts a bond escrowed by the protocol plus a per-epoch work proof graded by random peers: a cluster of lookalike accounts then pays N times the stake while sharing one payout, so duplication loses money. Rewards track stake-weighted reputation decayed over time, a jade ledger that appreciates only for verified distinct operators. The yarrow-thin profit margin per fake identity vanishes once stake plus grading cost exceeds the epoch subsidy, and any zephyr of duplicated activity flags the cluster for slashing.
